missions.instruction: Fix merge() in merge_web_source.py. Archive sha(archive) then ZipFile(archive), and overlay sha(source) then shutil.copyfile(source,target), each reopen a pathname after checking its pin. A replaced pathname can substitute unverified bytes. For each overlay, hash the exact bytes copied from one opened descriptor into a temporary file in the target directory, verify the expected hash and stable source before atomically replacing the target; clean up on failure. Preserve existing target permissions when replacing overlays; new targets retain normal creation permissions (0666 filtered by umask), without adding executable bits. Preserve sha(path), V4/V11 pins, existing archive/overlay path guards, valid union output and unchanged unrelated files. Change only this source and run the existing immutable verifier.
